beats.say: Zendaya is reportedly campaigning for Best Actress in Dune Part Three.
IGN reports she will push for the top acting award as Chani.
Born in Oakland, California, she already holds two Primetime Emmy Awards for Euphoria.
Yet 2026 became her biggest year on cinema screens.
She reprised Michelle Jones Watson in Spider-Man Brand New Day, whilst starring in both The Odyssey and The Drama.
Instead of settling for supporting status, her sci-fi journey now targets Hollywood's biggest honour.
Will Dune Part Three finally bring Zendaya her first Oscar win?
